thread:
anya_marketing: Need quick alignment on customer-facing wording and who receives emails for the eu-north incident. Goal: minimize panic, route impacted high-value accounts to CS/AE.

peter_sre: Root cause still unknown; we're failing over affected nodes. Recommend: post an "Investigating" line immediately, an "Update" at 30m, declare "Mitigated" when error rate <1% for 10m. RCA within 36h.

anya_marketing: Draft public status blurb? Keep it non-technical and include link to status.

peter_sre: Suggested blurb:
```
Investigating: Were seeing elevated errors for inference in eu-north. Engineers are investigating and we'll share updates on https://status.redwood.ai. No data loss observed.
```

morgan_csm: CS plan: tag accounts with >$5k monthly spend or >200k tokens/day during window. Those get an immediate DM and an offer for a priority ops call. Others get an in-console banner and status page link only.

ira_sales: For inbound demos or trials from impacted orgs, mark as priority and notify the AE. Offer Dedicated trial if they need guaranteed stability for demos.

anya_marketing: Email template for targeted outreach (short):
```
Subject: Redwood update  eu-north service alert

Hi <FirstName>,

Were investigating degraded inference performance in the eu-north region. Our team is working to restore normal service; ticket: <TICKET_LINK>. If this affects critical flows, reply to request a priority ops call or ask your AE about Dedicated routing.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

morgan_csm: Good. Add one line about compensation handled privately by AE if required.

peter_sre: Agreed. Also: avoid committing to timestamps in public copy.

notifbot: Incident INC-2026-721 created by peter_sre at 1932100012.

anya_marketing: Plan: publish public status and console banner now, CS to prepare targeted emails and AEs notified for priority routing. Will post the 30m progress update and follow with RCA in 36h. Thanks all.
